description.en: A fossil algal frond has a central axis and repeated upward-curving lateral units.
description.zh: 化石藻叶状体具中央轴及重复向上弯曲侧单元。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Buthograptus laxus, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Buthograptus laxus 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Pinnate curved lateral units differ from radial whorls and equal ribbon forks; it is not a fern.
distinctness.zh: 羽状弯曲侧单元区别于放射轮枝和等分带叉，并非蕨类。

modeling_brief.en: Use an open comb-like relief with curved tapered side elements; do not add terrestrial roots or leaf venation.
modeling_brief.zh: 用弯曲渐细侧元构成疏开梳状浮雕，不加陆生根或叶脉。

uncertainty: Green-algal placement follows the modern revision; delicate original tissue depth is unknown.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
